args:
{
    logId: v.id("aiLogs"),
    status: v.union(
      v.literal("success"),
      v.literal("failed"),
      v.literal("pending_approval"),
      v.literal("approved"),
      v.literal("rejected"),
      v.literal("request_changes"),
    ),
    userFeedback: v.optional(v.string()),
  }

{
    reservationKey: v.string(),
    evidenceSource: v.union(
  v.literal("google_api_response"),
  v.literal("google_cloud_billing_export"),
  v.literal("google_support_confirmation"),
  v.literal("anthropic_api_response"),
  v.literal("anthropic_usage_report"),
  v.literal("anthropic_support_confirmation"),
  v.literal("openai_api_response"),
  v.literal("openai_usage_report"),
  v.literal("openai_support_confirmation"),
),
    evidenceReference: v.string(),
    outcome: v.union(
      v.object({ kind: v.literal("known_not_billed") }),
      v.object({
        kind: v.literal("known_billed"),
        actualInputTokens: v.number(),
        actualOutputTokens: v.number(),
        providerRequestId: v.optional(v.string()),
      }),
    ),
  }

{
    limit: v.optional(v.number()),
    cursor: v.optional(v.string()),
    statusFilter: v.optional(
      v.union(
        v.literal("success"),
        v.literal("failed"),
        v.literal("pending"),
        v.literal("refunded"),
        v.literal("canceled"),
      ),
    ),
    eventTypeFilter: v.optional(v.string()),
  }

{
    status: v.optional(
      v.union(
        v.literal("success"),
        v.literal("failed"),
        v.literal("pending_approval"),
        v.literal("approved"),
        v.literal("rejected"),
        v.literal("request_changes"),
      ),
    ),
    workflowType: v.optional(v.string()),
    limit: v.optional(v.number()),
    cursor: v.optional(v.string()),
  }

{
    repositoryId: v.id("repositories"),
    settings: v.object({
      issueAssistantEnabled: v.boolean(),
      autoFormatIssue: v.boolean(),
      autoAnswerQuestions: v.boolean(),
      tagMaintainersForCodeChanges: v.boolean(),
      issueResponseStyle: v.optional(v.string()),
      requireApproval: v.boolean(),
      discussionAssistantEnabled: v.boolean(),
      autoFormatDiscussion: v.boolean(),
      autoAnswerDiscussionQuestions: v.boolean(),
      tagMaintainersForDiscussionCodeChanges: v.boolean(),
      discussionResponseStyle: v.optional(v.string()),
      requireApprovalForDiscussions: v.boolean(),
      pullRequestReviewsEnabled: v.optional(v.boolean()),
      pullRequestSuggestionsEnabled: v.optional(v.boolean()),
      requireApprovalForPullRequests: v.optional(v.boolean()),
    }),
  }

{
    githubRepo: v.optional(v.string()),
    status: v.optional(v.union(v.literal("open"), v.literal("closed"))),
    ticketType: v.optional(
      v.union(
        v.literal("issue"),
        v.literal("discussion"),
        v.literal("pull_request"),
      ),
    ),
    search: v.optional(v.string()),
    limit: v.optional(v.number()),
    offset: v.optional(v.number()),
  }

{
    minimumAgeConfirmed: v.literal(true),
    professionalUseConfirmed: v.literal(true),
    termsAccepted: v.literal(true),
    privacyPolicyAccepted: v.literal(true),
    displayedTermsVersion: v.string(),
    displayedPrivacyPolicyVersion: v.string(),
  }
